title: Stories From The Skies: Pararescuemen train on U.S. Army CH-47 Chinook
description:
U.S. Air Force pararescuemen assigned to the 83rd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron, train to
treat and transport a pilot suffering from ejection related injuries in an U.S Army CH-47 Chinook
Feb. 22, 2018. Pararescuemen conduct training on tactical insertion and patrolling as a unit to
hone their skills, providing the highest level of tactical capabilities to commanders throughout
the area of operations. (U.S. Air Force Imagery by Senior Airman Nathaniel Stout)
